summary: Completed frontend testing of Scholar Academic Writing Assistant. User registration and login work correctly, but critical session persistence issues remain. Protected routes redirect users to login, preventing access to core functionality like assignment creation.

flaky_endpoints.issue: Dashboard stats API returning errors - 'Failed to load dashboard data' message shown
flaky_endpoints.workaround: User interface still functional despite error

ui_bugs.issue: Users redirected to login when accessing /new-assignment after successful authentication
Dashboard shows 'Failed to load dashboard data' error banner

integration_issues.issue: JWT token not properly persisted when navigating between protected pages

passed_tests: Landing page loads with Scholar branding and proper layout
User registration form accepts valid input and creates account
Dashboard displays user welcome message with correct name
Dashboard shows 4 stat cards (Total Assignments, Completed, Total Words, Total Spent)
Login form displays correctly with email/password fields
User authentication works for initial login/registration
Scholar branding and UI elements render correctly
Form validation works for required fields
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix JWT token persistence issue in AuthContext. Users cannot access protected routes (/new-assignment) after successful login/registration - they get redirected back to login page. This blocks the core assignment creation workflow. Also investigate dashboard stats API intermittent failures.
